name: Los Angeles and Long Beach (anchorages only, PARTIAL)
source: 33 CFR 110.214 (Los Angeles and Long Beach harbors, California), datum NAD 83 as stated in 110.214(b). Anchorages F and G: final rule 90 FR 43392, 9 Sept 2025, effective 9 Oct 2025, tables 6 and 7 (https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2025-09-09/pdf/2025-17318.pdf). Anchorages B, C, D and E: full text of 110.214 as published by FindLaw, marked current as of 2 Jan 2025 (https://codes.findlaw.com/cfr/title-33-navigation-and-navigable-waters/cfr-sect-33-110-214/); the 2025 rule does not amend these paragraphs. Read 2026-11-24. eCFR itself could not be opened from the agent sandbox; check every vertex against eCFR before a real run.
missing: no berth areas yet; container terminal berths must be drawn from a sourced chart or port map, not from memory
notes: Vertices are copied as printed in the source, in the source's order; the last vertex joins the first, as the regulation says.
NAD 83 and the WGS 84 used by AIS differ by about a metre or two here, far less than an anchorage.

Left out on purpose: sub-anchorage circles inside B and D (already inside those polygons), the explosives anchorage (a circle, used only when activated), and general anchorages N, P and Q (small craft; parts of their bounds follow shorelines with no coordinates printed).
Anchorage A (Los Angeles Harbor) was removed in 2015 (79 FR 71654), as the 2025 rule notes.
